name: Big Three Perfectionism Scale — Socially Prescribed Perfectionism facet (BTPS-SPP)
rights: The BTPS supplementary instrument states: Copyright by Martin M. Smith. All rights reserved. Permission granted to use and reproduce this measure for academic and research purposes.
items: People expect too much from me.
People are disappointed in me whenever I don’t do something perfectly.
People make excessive demands of me.
Everyone expects me to be perfect.

scoring.method: Sum the four Socially Prescribed Perfectionism facet items.

interpretation_note: Higher scores indicate greater socially prescribed perfectionism on the BTPS facet. This is not the Hewitt-Flett MPS SPP subscale and scores are not interchangeable.
